command.outlineFile: Ai Work Harness: Outline Current File
config.maxResponseLength.description: Maximum response length in tokens (0 = let the model decide)
config.enableWorkspaceContext.descriptio: Enable workspace context for the AI agent
config.enableTerminalSuggestions.descrip: Enable run terminal command suggestions tool
config.systemPrompt.description: System prompt or custom instruction field
config.todoCodeLensEnabled.description: Show "Implement with Ai Work Harness" above TODO comments.
config.executionMode.description: Run commands on the host or inside a restricted Docker container. Container mode requires Docker and a pre-pulled image.
config.browserExecutablePath.description: Optional Chrome or Chromium executable for isolated browser verification. An installed Chrome or Edge is detected automatically.
config.graphifyPath.description: Optional absolute path to the graphify CLI used by the knowledge graph. When empty, graphify is looked up on PATH.
config.containerImage.description: Existing Docker image used for command execution. Images are never pulled automatically.
config.containerNetwork.description: Allow outbound networking for container commands.
config.containerMemoryMb.description: Container command memory limit in MiB.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: In untrusted workspaces, project-level hooks from .cursor/hooks.json and .claude/settings.json are disabled. Trust the workspace (and approve its hook file) to run them.
